name: source-panel
notes: Twenty newly scored clips: five real Ego4D, five real YouTube-VOS, five generated Cosmos, five generated Wan 2.2-14B. Source labels and generator attribution follow the dataset author cards. See configs/source-panel-selection.md. Source, content, encoding and viewpoint differ across groups; native sampling uses nominal constant-fps timing. Five Ego4D clips show two room setups, and three Wan clips share a construction scene. Counts describe this convenience pilot, not independent trials or population accuracy. Checkpoint training overlap is unknown. No calibration, threshold tuning or deployment change is made.
